display_title: Caution! Do Not Cross the Safety Line
description:
Min-Jae, who gave up his dream of becoming a teacher due to an incident during his days as a teacher. Now a cafe owner, he meets Hye-Seong, who was his cute student during his days as a teacher, at a class reunion. Hye-Seong, who has become a screenwriter, needs to write a sex scene, and his teacher asks for Min-Jae's help by making an absurd suggestion to date him for two months. Min-Jae thinks it's ridiculous to date a former student, so he pushes Hye-Seong away, but Hye-Seong keeps violating Min-Jae's safety line...

 *"This is my first time experiencing something like this... Teacher, what's my score right now?"* 

Will Min-Jae be able to push away Hye-Seong, who has gone from a cute student to a bold and straightforward younger man?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
